CreateRoute.routeName: Route name, 2–64 characters, unique within the same instance
CreateRoute.srcProduct: Source product identifier, not required for external users
CreateRoute.accessMode: Access mode, either API or Web, defaults to API
CreateRoute.webSubdomain: Standalone subdomain for Web mode, required when accessMode is Web
CreateRoute.servicePath: Backend service path for Web mode, required when accessMode is Web, must start with `/`
CreateRoute.domains: List of custom domains bound in API mode; uses instance default domain when empty
CreateRoute.matchRules: Route matching rules; Web mode must use prefix match on `/`
CreateRoute.matchRules.pathRule: Path matching rule, contains matchType, value, and caseSensitive
CreateRoute.matchRules.headers: Request header matching rules, each item contains key, matchType, and value
CreateRoute.matchRules.queryParams: Query parameter matching rules, each item contains key, matchType, and value
CreateRoute.multiService: Whether to enable multi-service, defaults to false; not supported in Web mode
CreateRoute.trafficDistributionStrategy: Multi-service traffic distribution strategy, either ratio or model_name, required when multiService is true
CreateRoute.enableWeightAdjust: Whether to enable dynamic weight adjustment, applies only to multi-service ratio strategy, defaults to false
CreateRoute.targetService: Target service; pass an object for single-service, pass `List<TargetService>` for multi-service
CreateRoute.rewrite: Standard path rewrite configuration; path is required when enabled is true
CreateRoute.regexRewrite: Regex path rewrite configuration, takes priority over standard path rewrite
CreateRoute.customHeaders: Custom request headers set when forwarding requests
CreateRoute.skipSetHostHeader: Whether to skip automatic Host header injection for FIXED_IP or DNS_DOMAIN services
CreateRoute.authEnabled: Whether to enable consumer authentication, defaults to false
CreateRoute.allowedConsumers: List of consumer IDs allowed to access, at least one required when authEnabled is true
CreateRoute.tokenRateLimit: Token rate limit configuration; at least one rule_item required when enabled is true
CreateRoute.requestRateLimit: Request rate limit configuration; at least one rule_item required when enabled is true
CreateRoute.corsPolicy.enabled: Whether to enable the CORS policy
CreateRoute.corsPolicy.allowOrigins: Allowed origins, each item contains matchType and value
CreateRoute.corsPolicy.maxAge: Preflight request cache duration in seconds
CreateRoute.responseHeaders.enabled: Whether to enable custom response headers
CreateRoute.fallbackConfig.specifiedModelName: Fixed model name used when modelNameMode is specify
